remarks: PRICE REDUCED!!  Enjoy living in this spacious two story vinyl-sided home featuring 6 bedrooms and two full bathrooms situate on 3.9 acres.  Conveniently located near Lake Erie and Point Gratiot, this property offers plenty of space both inside and out.  The front entrance leads to a formal dining room with beamed ceilings, hardwood floors, a large living room with wood-burning fireplace, an extra room ,and a first floor laundry room that could be converted back into a seventh bedroom if desired. The living room flows into a fully remodeled kitchen featuring quartz countertops, a center island, new cabinetry and all new appliances, which are included.  The eat-in kitchen is highlighted by sliding glass patio doors that open onto a large multi-level Trex deck. Both kitchen and newly renovated bathroom have new laminate flooring. The 2nd floor has a total of 6 bedrooms and one full bath. Home has four-zone baseboard heating. There is a detached 3 bay garage with electricity and  the back building could store 6 cars.  Also features large chain lined fenced area. The roof on the house and garage was replaced  in 2022.   The back deck creates the perfect setting for outdoor entertaining or relaxing while enjoying the  back yard and sunset.
